author: Top Gear
description:
This is the JCB Hydromax, a streamliner with two engines and 1600hp! In the hands of Andy Green OBE (he who drove Thrust SSC to 763mph…) it’s just rocketed past 400mph to claim a new World Land Speed Record as the fastest hydrogen-powered vehicle of any kind in history, and in this video Top Gear has a full tour of the Hydromax with 'The Fastest Man Of Earth’…
